title: tridentopsis mutica var. elongata

It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian cultures for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues. Elongated Tridentopsis has been found to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and wound-healing properties.
